text_block_list.name: Shadow Golshi
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゴルシ様
ふっかぁーーーーーつ！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still not done playing, huh...
Shadow Golshi-san sure is greedy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ遊び足りんやなんて……
シャドウゴルシさんはほんま欲張りさんやなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case, as many times as you wish...
I'll gladly face you until you're satisfied.
text_block_list.orig_text:
であれば、
何度でも……
満足できるまで
お相手させていただきます。

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Competing against a formidable opponent is always fun, no matter how many times we do it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
強敵との勝負は
何回やっても楽しいもの。

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And in the end──
we'll be the ones who win!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして最後は──
絶対、
わたしたちが勝つのよ！
